observations: Three photos show a light-colored wooden desk with a built-in shelf and a curved cutout on the front edge.
The desk has a single shelf below the main surface, supported by two vertical side panels.
The front panel has a curved cutout, likely for a monitor or keyboard tray.
The desk appears to be made of particle board or MDF with a light wood veneer finish.
No visible brand or model markings on the desk in any photo.
The desk is shown in a room with tiled flooring and an orange wall.
A power cable and adapter are visible on the floor next to the desk in photos 0 and 1.

claims.claim: Sturdy desk with built-in PC space
claims.evidence: The desk appears to have a solid frame and a shelf, but there is no visible proof of its structural strength or the depth of the PC space. The photos do not show the underside or any internal components.

risks.risk: The desk may not be sturdy enough for a PC or may have structural weaknesses.
risks.proof: A photo showing the underside of the desk, including the legs and joints, and a close-up of the shelf and PC space depth.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or not suitable for a PC

risks.risk: The PC space may be shallow or not deep enough for a monitor or keyboard.
risks.proof: A photo showing the depth of the cutout on the front panel, ideally with a ruler or object placed inside to show dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly insufficient for a monitor

risks.risk: The desk may have hidden damage or defects not visible in the photos, such as warping, cracks, or loose joints.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the entire desk from all angles, including the back and sides, and a close-up of the joints and edges.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly damaged or incomplete

proof_requests: Photo of the underside of the desk showing the legs and joints.
Photo showing the depth of the PC space with a ruler or object inside.
Photo of the back and sides of the desk to check for damage or warping.
Video or photo showing the desk from all angles, including the cutout and shelf.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
